theta.bed.too_small: You are too small to sleep in bed!
theta.bed.too_big: You are too big to sleep in bed!
command.theta.help.desc: List of all subcommands and their descriptions
command.theta.size.get.desc: Returns current size of selected entity (or self) in chat
command.theta.size.set.desc: Sets the size of selected entity. Can be instant or animated.
command.theta.size.add.desc: Adds a number to the size of selected entity
command.theta.size.sub.desc: Subtracts a number from the size of selected entity
command.theta.size.mul.desc: Multiplies the number of the seleced entity by the given number
command.theta.size.div.desc: Divides the number of the seleced entity by the given number
